requirements_summary: Live slot and leader monitoring via Yellowstone/Geyser or compatible stream.
Dynamic bundle tips from recent tip data and network conditions.
Lifecycle tracking across Submitted, Processed, Confirmed, Finalized.
Failure classification and automatic retries with blockhash refresh.
Lifecycle log from at least 10 real bundle submissions including at least 2 failure cases.
Public architecture document separate from GitHub repository.

components.name: slot_stream_adapter
components.responsibility: Consume live slot, leader, and transaction stream events.

components.name: leader_window_detector
components.responsibility: Detect when submission timing is favorable.

components.name: bundle_tip_calculator
components.responsibility: Compute non-hardcoded bundle tip suggestions from recent data.

components.name: bundle_submitter
components.responsibility: Submit bundles and record submission metadata.

components.name: lifecycle_tracker
components.responsibility: Track commitment progression, slots, timestamps, and latency deltas.

components.name: ai_ops_decisioner
components.responsibility: Make a bounded decision such as retry, tip increase, or abandon based on evidence.

first_safe_experiment: Build a non-mutating simulator with synthetic bundle lifecycle events and validate the evidence ledger format before any real submissions.
blockers: No approved wallet or budget for bundle submissions.
No human approval for public repository or public architecture doc.
